import inspect

import solution
from solution import len_log


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: len_log(["python","PHP","bigdata"]) == 7."""
    assert len_log(["python", "PHP", "bigdata"]) == 7  # max(6,3,7)=7


def test_issue_single_word():
    """Find the length of the longest word with one word."""
    assert len_log(["hello"]) == 5  # len("hello")=5


def test_issue_longest_first():
    """Find the length of the longest word when it is first."""
    assert len_log(["elephant", "cat", "dog"]) == 8  # max(8,3,3)=8


def test_issue_longest_last():
    """Find the length of the longest word when it is last."""
    assert len_log(["cat", "dog", "elephant"]) == 8  # max(3,3,8)=8


def test_issue_longest_middle():
    """Find the length of the longest word when it is in the middle."""
    assert len_log(["cat", "elephant", "dog"]) == 8  # max(3,8,3)=8


def test_issue_tie_returns_common_length():
    """Find the length of the longest word when all tie."""
    assert len_log(["abcd", "wxyz"]) == 4  # max(4,4)=4


def test_issue_empty_string_among_words():
    """Find the length of the longest word ignoring empty words."""
    assert len_log(["", "a", "abcde"]) == 5  # max(0,1,5)=5


def test_issue_single_empty_string():
    """Find the length of the longest word for empty word."""
    assert len_log([""]) == 0  # len("")=0


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface shows def len_log(list1)."""
    assert callable(len_log)


def test_contract_takes_one_argument():
    """Public interface shows def len_log(list1) takes one argument."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(len_log).parameters) == 1  # 1 parameter: 1==1


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Find the length of the longest word returns length as int."""
    result = len_log(["ab", "abcd"])  # lengths 2,4; max(2,4)=4
    assert isinstance(result, int)
